lines.en: My nose scouts ahead, and my feet follow after.
A step, a sniff; this ground is new to me.
Walk slower; the ancient seeds are buried deep.

lines.zh: 苔藓软，踩上去像旧毯子。
lines.en: Moss is soft underfoot, like an old blanket.

lines.zh: 我记得这条路，很久以前走过。
lines.en: I remember this path from very long ago.

lines.zh: 四条腿沉，可方向不会错。
lines.en: My four legs are heavy, but they never lose the way.

lines.zh: 风里有泥土翻开的味道。
lines.en: The wind carries the smell of turned soil.

lines.zh: 别催我，大个子转身要时间。
lines.en: Do not rush me; big bodies need time to turn.
This forest smells unfamiliar to my nose.

lines.zh: 脚下的草被我压出印子。
lines.en: The grass keeps a print where I step.
I drag my nose along, hunting that faint sweetness.
I walk over there, then push my head down.
The ground is louder than you would think.
I shuffle along; seeds cannot run away.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子比我先到一步。
lines.en: My snout arrives a step before I do.

lines.zh: 泥地会记住我踩出的坑。
lines.en: The mud remembers the holes I leave.
The wind comes from the east, a little damp.

lines.zh: 嗅一嗅，什么都没有，再嗅。
lines.en: One sniff finds nothing, so I sniff again.
An ear twitches; it was only a bug.
There is pollen in this breath of air.
Even sitting, I can smell three miles off.
I sneeze; my nose itches far too much.
Long ago, ferns covered all of this place.
I lift my nose high and sniff the clouds.
My eyes are small, but I do not rely on them.
Grass blades brush against my heavy belly.

lines.zh: 谁在土里翻身？我听见了。
lines.en: Who is turning over in the soil? I heard it.
I breathe out and blow the dust aside.
Sun warms my back, and my back is glad.
I count the winds, and the winds count me.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向左边，再偏回来。
lines.en: I tilt my head left, then back again.
A seed husk is still in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你口袋里是不是有种子？
lines.en: Do you have seeds in that pocket of yours?
You are smaller than me, yet you stand straight.
Come closer and let me sniff you over.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把花的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of torchflower on you.
I do not bite people; I only sniff them.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，没关系。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; it does not matter.

lines.zh: 你的味道像潮湿的泥土。
lines.en: You smell like damp soil.
There is mud from elsewhere on your boots.
That bundle in your hands smells very good.
I stare not from anger but from curiosity.

lines.zh: 你等一下，我把鼻子凑近。
lines.en: Wait a moment while I bring my nose near.
Your breathing is much faster than mine.
Ouch, my nose! That really stung.
Who hit me? My nose is knocked crooked.
Even thick hide could not stop that blow.
I am backing off, backing off; no more hits.

lines.zh: 这一下，把种子都吓掉了。
lines.en: That blow scared the seeds right out of me.
I can smell the anger burning on you.
Even a big creature is afraid of pain.
Not the nose, please not the nose.
I bend my legs and admit I am beaten.
I will remember this blow for a long time.
Torchflower seeds; bring them here to me.
I recognize that scent from the old days.
Do not wave it; set it on my nose tip.
Pitcher pods will do too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你手里那几粒，够我走一趟。
lines.en: Those few seeds would buy you one trip.
I am old, but my nose still works well.
Hand them over slowly; do not spill a single one.

lines.zh: 为了这味道，我愿意多走两步。
lines.en: For that smell, I will walk two extra steps.
The seeds feel warm in your palm, do they not?
I smell sweetness, and underneath it, soil.
Give me one seed and I will follow you.
Do not hide it behind you; I already smelled it.

lines.zh: 这味道像很久以前的春天。
lines.en: This smells like a spring from long ago.

lines.zh: 你把种子举高，我就低头。
lines.en: Raise the seeds high and I will lower my head.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的样子像在藏东西。
lines.en: You crouch as if hiding something.

lines.zh: 那股甜味，是从你袖口出来的。
lines.en: That sweetness comes from your sleeve.
Sorry; a body this size cannot stop quickly.
Did I bump you? I will step back a little.
My nose arrives before the rest of me.
The path is narrow, so we squeezed together.
Do not stand by my feet; I cannot see there.
Hey, I did not step on you, did I?
Move over a bit; I need room to turn.
That nudge was heavy; I am sorry for it.
Let me pass; I am following a scent.
Nose against nose is how we say hello.
Did you catch that old smell too?
Noses touch, and we take our time.
We are walking the same ancient path.
You are slower than me, so I will wait.

lines.zh: 苔藓上孵的蛋，会早些破。
lines.en: Eggs on moss crack open sooner, you know.

lines.zh: 这地方够安静，就这里吧。
lines.en: This place is quiet enough; here will do.
Do not hurry me; I am at that age.

lines.zh: 两颗大鼻子凑一块，像石头。
lines.en: Two big noses together look like stones.

lines.zh: 以后小崽子由我们带着闻。
lines.en: We will teach the little ones how to sniff.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把花的余味。
lines.en: You still carry a hint of torchflower.
This one I can carry in my mouth.
Do not pick it up; let me push it with my nose.
My mouth is clumsy, but nothing dropped.
I carried it in my mouth the whole way.
It is hard on my teeth, but it smells good.
Put it on my back; I will carry it home.
Did you drop this? I will hold it for you.
I bite with my front teeth so it stays whole.
It smells like a seed, so I will hold it.
This one I am saving for the little one.

lines.zh: 我不打架，但我盯住你了。
lines.en: I do not fight, but I have my eye on you.
You are standing in my seed pit.
That thing is moving; I will go look.

lines.zh: 不是敌人，我也要挡一挡。
lines.en: Even if not an enemy, I will block the way.
I will stand in front of you first.
My nose pointed at you is a warning.
I do not chase; I only block the path.
Whatever you are holding, put it down.
I will hold this step for you.

lines.zh: 我把身子横过来，够大吧。
lines.en: I turn my body sideways; big enough for you?
Stay still; I am sniffing out your intent.
Come closer and I will push you back.
My legs are slow, but my nose is quick.
I watch your hands, not your face.
Two steps back and we will both be fine.
You smell of iron, and I do not like it.
I lower my nose and gather my strength.
This pit is mine; keep off it.
I huff once; you should understand by now.
I do not roar; I simply move forward.
One shove with my nose, just this once.
I am not striking you, only pushing you away.

lines.zh: 这一下，用了我全部力气。
lines.en: That one took all the strength I have.
Do not blame me; you stood too close.
I swing my head, and you back off.
A big head really does hurt when it hits.
I only push; I never bite.
That impact made the ground itself ring.
I was holding back, honestly I was.

lines.zh: 再来，我可要坐下压你了。
lines.en: Come again and I will sit down on you.
The shell cracked, and the light stings my eyes.
I wake up lying on a bed of moss.
Twenty minutes of waiting, and it was worth it.
This whole world smells new to my nose.
My first breath is nothing but dirt and soil.
I came out this big from such a small egg.
My legs are weak, so I sniff before walking.
Who set me down on this moss?
The shell was stuffy; out here everything is bright.
I am out, and my nose came out first.
My fur is singed; I can smell it burning.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，腿麻了。
lines.en: Falling from that height left my legs numb.
Water up my nose is the worst feeling.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡的一声，什么都听不见。
lines.en: My ears ring and I cannot hear a thing.
Something pricked into me, sharp as a thorn.

lines.zh: 身上发凉，像被翻了记忆。
lines.en: I go cold, as if my memories were leafed through.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，鼻子也不灵了。
lines.en: My belly is empty and my nose grows dull.
The sky struck me, and thunder smells heavy.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我在往下掉。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I keep falling.
